text:
I

I would trace three lessons
with a burning pen that scorched deeply,
leaving a trail of blessed light
wherever a mortal heart beats.


II

Have Hope. If there are storm clouds,
if there are disappointments and no illusions,
unfurrow your brow; its shadow is vain,
for every night is followed by a morning.


III

Have Faith. Wherever your boat is driven
by roaring breezes or raging waves,
God (do not forget) rules heaven,
and earth, and breezes, and the little boat.


IV

Have Love, and love not just one being,
for we are brothers from pole to pole,
and spend your love for everyone's good,
as the sun pours out its friendly light.


V

Grow, love, hope! Engrave the three within you,
and wait firm and serene
for strength where others may founder,
light when many wander in darkness.

translation.title: Three Lessons I Would Trace...
